# Container

<p class="gls-text-lead">This component allows you to align and center your page content.</p>

## Usage

Add the `.gls-container` class to a block element to give it a max-width and wrap the main content of your website. The element will be centered and have padding on the sides, that adapts automatically for large screens.

**Note** The padding of nested containers will be removed to avoid unnecessary spacing.

```html
<div class="gls-container"></div>
```

---

## Size modifiers

Add one of the following classes to the container to apply a different max-width.

| Class                   | Description                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.gls-container-xsmall` | Add this class for a xsmall container.                                                                         |
| `.gls-container-small`  | Add this class for a small container.                                                                          |
| `.gls-container-large`  | Add this class for a large container.                                                                          |
| `.gls-container-xlarge` | Add this class for a xlarge container.                                                                         |
| `.gls-container-expand` | Add this class, if you do not want to limit the container width but still want the dynamic horizontal padding. |

```html
<div class="gls-container gls-container-xsmall"></div>

<div class="gls-container gls-container-small"></div>

<div class="gls-container gls-container-large"></div>

<div class="gls-container gls-container-xlarge"></div>

<div class="gls-container gls-container-expand"></div>
```

---

## Container in sections

You can apply this component to modify the width of content inside sections from the [Section component](https://getuikit.com/docs/section).

```html
<div class="gls-section gls-section-primary">
    <div class="gls-container gls-container-small"></div>
</div>
```

---

## Gloss stack

Gloss adds the Stack layout primitive to manage vertical spacing between stacked elements and override adjacent sibling margins cleanly:

| Class / Attribute     | Description                                                                                            |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.gls-stack`          | Base container element managing vertical spacing between child elements.                               |
| `.gls-stack-small`    | Applies a small gap (16px) between stacked children. Also supports `data-gls-gap="small"`.             |
| `.gls-stack-medium`   | Applies a medium gap (32px) between stacked children. Also supports `data-gls-gap="medium"`.           |
| `.gls-stack-large`    | Applies a large gap (48px, 64px at 1200px+) between stacked children. Supports `data-gls-gap="large"`. |
| `.gls-stack-collapse` | Collapses gap spacing to 0px. Also supports `data-gls-gap="none"`.                                     |

### Usage

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-stack gls-stack-medium">
    <div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body">
        <h3>First Block</h3>
        <p>Top child margin is normalized automatically.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body">
        <h3>Second Block</h3>
        <p>Separated by a consistent 32px vertical gap.</p>
    </div>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-stack gls-stack-medium">
    <div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body">
        <h3>First Block</h3>
        <p>Top child margin is normalized automatically.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="gls-card gls-card-default gls-card-body">
        <h3>Second Block</h3>
        <p>Separated by a consistent 32px vertical gap.</p>
    </div>
</div>
```
